description: Mint a public share token for a file. Returns a `url` of the form `https://trydock.ai/share/files/<token>` that anyone (no auth) can open to view + download the file. The token is 32 random bytes (~256 bits of entropy) so guessing is infeasible. Revoke later with `revoke_file_share`. Editor role required. Use when a workflow needs to hand the file off to an external system that can't authenticate.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

name: share_file
